pi.frontmatter:
name: tracking-doc-format
description: "把下载的埋点文档 .csv 整理成按埋点 key 分段的可读文本：埋点名 / 上报时机 / 参数（参数名 + 类型 + 说明）。默认先逐条输出单个埋点、用户确认后再出下一条，全部对完才出全文（段间 ----------- 加空行）；每段带上报点，末尾附核对记录；实现后按文档核对埋点（上报点 / 参数 / 时机，W/I 编号）。埋点名、上报时机、参数、参数名分别加粗，不用颜色。触发：整理埋点文档 / 埋点 csv 格式化 / 按埋点 key 分段 / 埋点表转文档 / 逐条对埋点 / 埋点实现核对"

cursor.frontmatter:
name: tracking-doc-format
description: >-
  Format a tracking/analytics CSV into readable blocks per event key (name,
  firing condition, parameters with types and value sources). Output ONE event
  per message and wait for confirmation; emit the full document only after all
  events are confirmed. Markdown bold and blank lines; write *-format.md only
  when user explicitly asks to save. Also audits whether an existing implementation matches the doc (firing point, parameters, timing; W/I findings). Use for 埋点 csv 整理 or 埋点实现核对.
disable-model-invocation: false
